summary: Comprehensive backend + basic frontend testing of CardVault. Wrote pytest suite /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering all 8 domains (auth, contacts CRUD/filters/duplicates/merge, OCR, enrich, email settings, templates, campaigns, analytics) — 16/16 tests passing. Frontend web preview loads successfully: welcome → login → verify-otp → tabs flow works end-to-end; scan FAB renders centered in tab bar; all critical testIDs present; backend integration confirmed (invalid login shows 'Invalid credentials', successful verify-otp routes to home dashboard).

minor.issue: Emails are silently lowercased server-side; response echoes lowercase form regardless of what client sent. Not a bug but tests must compare with .lower().
Uses HTTPException 500 for OCR failures — consider 400 for invalid image payloads; currently OK because tesseract accepted a minimal white JPEG.
When SMTP creds are wrong but present, it still returns 200 with sent=0/failed=N. Consider surfacing at least one failure error in response summary (currently included in delivery[]).

issues: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Fires from tab-bar FAB shadow styles in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx. Cosmetic — RN Web deprecation warning only, no functional impact on native.

action_items: (Optional) Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow (or platform-branch to keep native shadows) in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx and any other component using shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset to silence RN Web console warnings.

(Optional) In send_campaign, if all attempts fail, consider raising 400 or returning ok=false so the client can surface the SMTP error clearly (currently delivery[].error carries it but the top-level ok=true can mislead).
critical_code_review_comments: OTP delivery relies on system SMTP; when unconfigured, send_system_email returns (True, 'system_smtp_not_configured') so signup silently succeeds. This is intentional dev-mode behavior — documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
Datetime handling mixes naive UTC (now = datetime.utcnow()) with tz-aware JWT expiries — internally consistent but consider timezone.utc across the board.
Enrich endpoint has no domain allowlist / SSRF protection — user-supplied website is fetched server-side. Fine for now, but worth noting for production.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of smoke checks (welcome, login, verify-otp, tabs, FAB)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test users prefixed TEST_ and test contacts prefixed TEST_ created by pytest; all contact/template/campaign resources are cleaned up by the tests themselves. Signup users remain in DB (no /api/auth/delete-account endpoint exists).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL: https://ocr-contacts-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api. To obtain OTP for a signed-up email, tail /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log and match regex 'OTP for {email_lower} \((signup|reset)\) = (\d{6})' (case-insensitive). Emails are lowercased server-side. Reuse /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. All 16 tests are currently green.
rca_of_issue: No open bugs. Two false-positive test failures during initial run were due to (a) case-sensitive OTP grep against server-lowercased emails and (b) case-sensitive email assertions in login/me responses — both fixed in the test file.
